name: kimi-quota-statusline-secure
description: A configurable, privacy-focused Kimi Code status line with session details and color-coded remaining quotas.

interface.shortDescription: Configurable session details and remaining quotas with no hooks, session-log access, or local HTTP server.
interface.longDescription: Displays permission mode, model, Plan mode, Git branch, working directory, and color-coded remaining 5h, 7d, and monthly quotas. Supports configurable items, thresholds, colors, and reset countdowns. Uses only the official Kimi usages API over allowlisted HTTPS endpoints. No third-party dependencies, OAuth token persistence, prompt hooks, session-log reads, debug snapshots, or HTTP server.
